_description: DEMO FIXTURE ONLY — fictional owners, illustrative globs. Mirrors the shape that titan-render.py generates from titan.config.json protected_paths[] so path-guard.py and sox-evidence.py can be demonstrated without touching a real config. Not deployed, not governance.

paths.why: SOX-relevant: these modules feed revenue recognition. Changes require a ticket, an approver who is not the author, and a recorded escalation reference.
paths.message: Revenue-relevant module. Stop, contact the area owner, and record the approval reference in the PR before changing this path.
